Sophia: Heads-up — planned infra apply tonight 22:00 UTC for release/2024.03. Touches: VPC route updates, peering, and cross-account IAM role creation. Also a tagging policy tweak.
Sophia: Can someone own the apply + rollout notes?
Daniel: I can own the apply. I'll be oncall and available in the window. What's the rollback trigger set?

Sophia: Added release notes link: https://confluence/internal/releases/2024.03 — see infra section under "Networking/IAM".
